thread:
Ravi: Quick ask  planning a brief 'mini-spot' activation across three offices in June to hand out small spot-award kits. Need volunteers, a packing owner, and a one-question pulse. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Hannah: Nice. Which offices and quantities?
Ravi: SF (6/3) 120, NY (6/10) 100, Dublin (6/17) 80, remote mailout ~300. Total ~600 + buffer.
Lee: I can run NY and help with remote packing.
Priya: I'll make a signup form with manager-only setup hour then open volunteer slots. Add a checkbox for people who can do last-mile mail runs.
ops_bot: Reminder: international shipments under A345 often avoid VAT in IE; consult shipping-guidelines. See https://redwood-internal/people-ops/shipping-guidelines
Hannah: What's in the kit? are any items cash-equivalent?
Ravi: Kit = handwritten note, enamel pin, snack, QR postcard linking to a single question: "Did this brighten your day? (yes/no)" No cash items by default. Any redemptions >$150 route through payroll.
Lee: I'll own the inventory sheet. Will include columns: SKU, qty ordered, qty received, packer initials, ship date, tax-review flag.
Priya: Adding time windows: 09:00-11:30, 12:00-15:00, 15:30-17:00 and an accessibility notes field. Draft signup: https://forms.gle/mini-spot-vols (please test).
Hannah: Procurement recs: use ParcelWave for remote drops. I'll request a quote for 300 packages and overnight options.
Ravi: Comms: need a 2-line blurb + slack banner one week ahead per office. Also a 2-bullet post-event summary for All Hands.
ops_bot: Inventory sheet will auto-flag unit values >150 for tax review. Link payroll-gift tax: https://redwood-internal/payroll/gift-tax
Priya: I'll finalize signup and blurb by Friday. Lee will finish inventory template by Thursday. Quick check-in at Wednesday standup. Thanks! :raised_hands:
